data_description.device_name: Used as device name and entity prefix, e.g. SP25

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check IP address, port and network standby.

data_description.playback_status: Adds a "Playback" entity: title, artist, cover art, position and play/pause/skip. Uses the built-in streamer's LUCI protocol (port 7777). Verified on the NP5 Prisma MK2; other models untested. Contributed by yvos.
data_description.max_volume: Home Assistant never sets a higher volume – slider, voice, automation or action. 99 = no limit. The device itself is not restricted.
data_description.inputs: One line per input: number = name (1–17). Leave empty for no input selection.

error.invalid_inputs: Invalid line. Format: 4 = HDMI ARC (number 1–17, each name only once).
